description: Holy water replaces the normal ranged max hit with its own formula off the visible Ranged level, a flat stance term of 10 and the vial's own ranged strength of 12, with 5 added when fighting Nezikchened. Because the replacement ceiling ignores the pipeline's max hit outright, ranged prayers such as Eagle Eye or Rigour and the Void ranger set effect do not raise it. The demons-only restriction is HolyWaterDemonsOnly's. Not modelled: the Defence drain on a landed hit, since asserted defence reductions are the player's to state as with the other drain weapons.

quotes: Maximum Hit = ⌊ ⌊ 0.5 + Visible Ranged Level + 10 * ( Ammo Ranged Strength + 64 ) 640 ⌋ * 1.6 (If fighting a demon) ⌋ + 5 (If fighting Nezikchened)
A stance bonus of 10 is used regardless of attack style used.
In the case of Holy water, the weapon's ranged strength is used instead.
the use of stat-boosting prayers such as Eagle Eye or Rigour will not, nor does the set effect of Void ranger armour apply to holy water
